avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Nephrotoxic Supplements (NSAIDs, high-dose vitamin C)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increased risk of acute kidney injury and crystalline nephropathy, particularly when combined with valacyclovir's renal clearance requirements
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if NSAIDs necessary, ensure adequate hydration and monitor renal function

caution_supplements.name: Probenecid
caution_supplements.mechanism: May compete for renal tubular secretion, potentially increasing valacyclovir levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects (headache, tremor); dose adjustment may be needed

caution_supplements.name: L-Lysine
caution_supplements.mechanism: Theoretical additive antiviral effect; no significant clinical interaction but monitor efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Concurrent use generally acceptable but monitor clinical response

caution_foods.name: High sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May affect renal function and fluid balance, indirectly impacting drug clearance
caution_foods.action: Maintain adequate hydration and moderate sodium intake, particularly in elderly or renally impaired patients

monitoring_notes: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) especially in elderly patients, those with pre-existing renal impairment, or concurrent nephrotoxic agents. Ensure adequate hydration to prevent crystalline nephropathy and maximize oral bioavailability.
